requirements.statement: Paired trials require equivalent starts, complete baseline/KEEL replicates, and fixed rubric metadata.
Benchmark scoring exposes outcome, adversarial violation, and execution-cost metrics without fabricating unavailable telemetry.
Reviewed observations may produce deferred evaluation targets, while promotion requires an evaluated result and a separate authorized KEEL change.
A requirement reaches BENCHMARKED only with reproducible improvement evidence and remains VERIFIED otherwise.
